messages:
maya: Hey team — draft of the product launch post is live: https://docs.redwood/launch/draft-v3. Asking for a quick pass on 4 things by EOD: 1) exec summary (one-liner), 2) benchmark claim phrasing + footnote, 3) webinar CTA + demo-invite matrix, 4) inbound lead routing (NA vs EMEA). Can you flag anything risky? :pray:

leo: On it. Quick Q — are the benchmark numbers from an internal Dedicated run or public comparison? we should be explicit about the benchmark environment if we call out percentages.

maya: Good call. Numbers are from Dedicated alpha on A100n pools (see sheet). I added a draft footnote but want legal to weigh in on wording. Current phrasing: 'up to 4x lower unit cost for common seq-length inference vs baseline fp16 serving.' Open to edit.

ashley: Legal quick-pass: please avoid absolutes like "4x" without context. Suggest: 'up to 4x in internal performance benchmarks; see methodology.' Also need measurement dates and config in the footnote. And remove any implication of SLA or guaranteed savings.

maya: Updated — added methodology link and measurement window (Mar 2026). Also annotated the claim with test seed and sequence lengths.

tara: Growth side — CTA variants we want to test: 1) Register for webinar, 2) Book a demo slot, 3) Request trial access. Routing plan: webinar -> marketing nurture, demo -> SDR queue, trial -> product ops for onboarding. For EMEA, route to EMEA SDR during 07:00-18:00 CET; fallback to NA after hours.

leo: Exec summary is a bit long. Proposed one-liner: 'Redwood Inference delivers predictable, lower-cost LLM inference for production applications.' Short and product-forward.

maya: Nice — swapping that in. Also planning a 3x3 demo-invite matrix (region x company size -> demo type). Draft CSV I pasted below for ops mapping:
```
region,company_size,demo_type,time_window
NA,SMB,Live-demo,ET mornings
NA,Enterprise,Technical deep-dive,ET afternoons
EMEA,SMB,Recorded + booking link,CEST mornings
EMEA,Enterprise,Live deep-dive,CEST afternoons
APAC,Any,Recorded + local-calendar,SGT weekdays
```

ops-bot: Reminder: Embargo rule in effect — DO NOT publish before 2026-04-08 17:00 UTC. Add `embargo: true` label to the doc and remove public links until embargo lifts. :lock:

ashley: Legal approves the revised footnote and measurement metadata. One request: change 'internal benchmarks' to 'internal performance benchmarks' for clarity.

tara: HubSpot mapping noted. I'll post the workflow mapping (nurture tags, lead score triggers, SDR queues) in this thread by 3pm and link the playbook. Also proposing two CTA variants for A/B: 'See the benchmark' vs 'Book a technical demo' — we'll split 60/40 default to demo.

maya: Thanks all. Plan: 1) lock copy with new exec one-liner, 2) add legal footnote + methodology link, 3) lock demo-invite matrix and handoff to ops + HubSpot, 4) send to design for hero image & CTAs. Final pass by 17:00 UTC? If no blockers I'll mark ready for review and schedule design requests. :rocket:
